sentences.en: A plasterer is a craftsman who applies plaster on walls.
A picture of the fugitive was plastered all over the newspapers.
sentences.zh: 2. 警方在报纸上刊登了通缉犯的照片。

sentences.en: He saw a small plaster on her left knee.
sentences.zh: 3. 他看到她左膝上贴着一块小膏药。

senses.zh: 石膏，灰泥；膏药，创可贴；石膏像；石膏模型
